name: Theophylline
summary: Theophylline, also known as 1,3-dimethylxanthine, is a drug that inhibits phosphodiesterase and blocks adenosine receptors. It is used to treat chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and asthma., theobromine and caffeine). Trace amounts of theophylline are naturally present in tea, coffee, chocolate, yerba mate, guarana, and kola nut.

pharmacology.text: Like other methylated xanthine derivatives, theophylline is a competitive nonselective phosphodiesterase inhibitor which increases intracellular levels of cAMP and cGMP, activates PKA, inhibits TNF-alpha and inhibits leukotriene synthesis, and reduces inflammation and innate immunity. Theophylline also acts as a nonselective adenosine receptor antagonist, antagonizing A1, A2, and A3 receptors almost equally, which explains many of its cardiac effects.

uses.text: It is used to treat chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and asthma.

summaryZh: 茶鹼（英語：Theophylline）是一種化學物質，廣泛存在於自然界中的紅茶和綠茶中，是一種磷酸二酯酶 抑制劑，可廣泛用於治療呼吸系統疾病。它與咖啡因共同存在於茶中，也具有與咖啡因類似的結構和藥理學特性，為一腺苷受體拮抗劑，可阻斷腺苷受體的作用。

sideEffects.en: The gap between a helpful and a toxic level is narrow. Common effects include nausea, headache, trouble sleeping and a racing heart, and toxic levels can cause vomiting, dangerous heart rhythms and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 有效濃度與中毒濃度之間的差距很小。常見影響包括噁心、頭痛、失眠與心跳加速，中毒時可能出現嘔吐、危險的心律不整與癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 有效浓度与中毒浓度之间的差距很小。常见影响包括恶心、头痛、失眠与心跳加速，中毒时可能出现呕吐、危险的心律不整与癫痫发作。

fact.en: Theophylline was first extracted from tea leaves in 1888 by the German scientist Albrecht Kossel. Its name comes from the Greek for divine leaf.
fact.zh: 茶鹼在1888年由德國科學家阿爾布雷希特．科塞爾首次從茶葉中萃取出來，它的名稱源自希臘文，意思是「神聖的葉子」。
fact.zhHans: 茶碱在1888年由德国科学家阿尔布雷希特．科塞尔首次从茶叶中萃取出来，它的名称源自希腊文，意思是「神圣的叶子」。
